metadata.license: Point descriptions: original short notes with source links. OSM-derived anchors and linework: ODbL 1.0. GSI coordinates: GSI terms linked in guide.

processing.boundary: Reuse Figure 5 wider outline from current study-atlas; no primary outline on this page; registration uncertainty 25 m retained
processing.route: Suggested stop order. Highlighted lines are named OSM streets, not a computed or checked walking path. Open the walking link for navigation and verify crossings/access on site.
processing.geocoding: Official address text -> GSI Address Search; retain request, returned title and exact response. Address-reference points do not assert surveyed building entrances.
processing.association: Contacts attached to a venue describe documented activity links, not head-office locations or town-association territories.
processing.source_reuse: Short paraphrases and links only. Official documents and images remain unchanged.
processing.past_event: The April Awa Dance street reference is separately mapped on Kanda Heisei-dori using the ward-stated section and existing OSM centre lines. It is not an event footprint.

properties.source: Theme B official brief, page 4, Figure 5 dashed black outline
properties.boundary_status: Cartographic source-stroke trace; geographic registration uncertainty retained
properties.outline_definition: Stroke center, preserving visible bends; separate traces by source

registration.method: Least-squares affine; no snapping to census edges
registration.uncertainty_definition: Conservative cartographic screening band; includes leave-one-control-out error, source stroke width and manual point reading. Not a statistical confidence interval.
registration.control_source: OSM source snapshot 2026-10-13, common foundation roads; average mapped carriageway intersections when divided

properties.authority: Official Theme B brief p.4 Figure 5 source stroke. Raster reference; geographic registration uncertainty retained.
properties.selection_rule: The fixed registered Figure 5 outline covers the complete original source footprint; exterior and crossing objects are context only, with no clipping.
properties.source_outline_role: Two official study levels overlaid in one common map view. No poster, census boundary or inferred operational outline.
properties.construction_method: Source-pixel vertices transformed with the recorded affine matrix; no road snapping, building expansion, straight trimming or branch interpretation.
